files.name: drum-sleeve
files.note: Scoring-drum sleeve, in a second colour: slide it over the drum (pin up the slot) and twist.

files.name: feeder-baffles
files.note: Two baffles, printed flat. Drop them in from the top onto the ledges inside, lower one first.

files.name: feeder-roof
files.note: Lift-off 20-degree roof. Prints on its end; lips under its ends hug the gables.

files.name: feeder-tower
files.note: Birdfeeder body: back, sides and front in one piece. Prints upright, no supports.

files.name: fit-test-coupon
files.note: Print first: checks the bowtie key fit, the bearing ring pin recess, a seam-pin hole, and a display-card slot (stand a card in it).

files.name: keys-x8
files.note: Eight bowtie keys that join the quarters. 100% infill, 0.12 mm layers.

files.name: quarter-cards
files.note: Printed card slots for the 3 face-up bird cards and 5 face-up hummingbird cards, the hummingbird discard tray and the Duet pocket. Floor down, 5 mm brim.

files.name: quarter-decks
files.note: Sockets for the two deck boxes and the hummingbird draw tray. Floor down, 5 mm brim.

files.name: quarter-feeder
files.note: Birdfeeder socket, dish, outside-the-feeder area, and the cradle the birdfeeder lies in for storage. Floor down, 5 mm brim.

files.name: quarter-food-eggs
files.note: Six food bins (45 tokens each) and the egg bin (75). Floor down, 5 mm brim.

files.name: scoring-drum-body-only
files.note: Multi-material printers only: the drum without its lift, in the same position as the lift-only file.

files.name: scoring-drum-lift-only
files.note: Multi-material printers only: the lift by itself, positioned to drop into the body-only file.

files.name: scoring-drum
files.note: Centre piece: inner scoring drum with goal-tile slots and a captive tile lift printed in place (push the tab down once to free it). For two colours, use the body-only and lift-only files.

files.name: storage-base-1
files.note: Storage base, one of four pieces. Floor down, 5 mm brim. Glue the seams.

files.name: storage-base-2
files.note: Storage base, one of four pieces. Floor down, 5 mm brim. Glue the seams.

files.name: storage-base-3
files.note: Storage base, one of four pieces. Floor down, 5 mm brim. Glue the seams.

files.name: storage-base-4
files.note: Storage base, one of four pieces. Floor down, 5 mm brim. Glue the seams.

files.name: storage-keys-x6
files.note: Six bowtie keys that join the storage base pieces.

files.name: storage-lid-cards
files.note: Optional storage lid, printed top down.

files.name: storage-lid-decks
files.note: Optional storage lid, printed top down.

files.name: storage-lid-feeder
files.note: Optional storage lid, printed top down.

files.name: storage-lid-food-eggs
files.note: Optional storage lid, printed top down.

hardware: The quarters rest on its top plate. Measure the hole positions before printing the quarters.
Cut from a 5 mm dowel or rod: one per quarter, through a ring hole into the quarter.
Acrylic deck boxes, 2.8 x 3 x 4 in (Mlikero 6-pack)
Bird deck with its discard behind a divider; bonus deck and discard.
Seam pins: 10 mm lengths of 1.75 mm filament
Under the bearing ring's bottom plate.
